> Stack: part 1 of 3 (this PR → #44552 → #44553).
>
> Kimi-K3 on gfx950 series (all drafts): #44547 gfx950 verify argmax + tuned rows, #44548 KDA, #44549 MLA decode, #44550 MLA prefill, #44551 → #44552 → #44553 collectives, MoE decode, MoE prefill. The end-to-end numbers in each PR are for all seven together.

## Motivation

At Kimi-K3 decode sizes the TP8 collectives and the attention-residual (AttnRes) reads that consume their output
are separate small launches per layer: the attention output's all-reduce, the residual add and the FFN-side bank
read; the MoE all-reduce, the replicated latent tail (norm + 3584 -> 7168 up-projection + shared + residual add) and
the next layer's attention-side read. Each rank also computes the whole replicated tail GEMM.

## Modifications

Gated on gfx950 TP8 (`layers/communication/k3_ll_comm_hip.get_comm()`).

- `comm/ll_hip.cuh`: a low-latency push protocol over a dedicated aiter CustomAllreduce's IPC meta buffer: senders
  write 16-byte lines of 8 payload bytes + an epoch flag into the receiver's scratch, receivers poll their own;
  no barrier (a line is rewritten two epochs later).
- `attn_res/read_hip.cuh` + `k3_attn_res_read_hip.py`, fused with the AttnRes read (softmax over the bank rows and
  the stream, RMSNorm):
  - the attention output's one-shot all-reduce + residual add + FFN-side read, for 4-row batches (EAGLE C1 verify;
    `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FUSED_ATTN_AR_READ`), and an opt-in two-shot variant for 5-64 rows
    (`SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FUSED_ATTN_AR_READ_MAX_ROWS`, off by default: slower than aiter's all-reduce + the Triton read);
  - the column-parallel latent tail: each rank runs the tail GEMM on 1/8 of the replicated up_proj rows as split-K
    fp32 partials (`k3_latent_tail_partials`), and the all-gather kernel finishes its slice (/rms, + shared
    [+ residual]), gathers the stream and runs the next layer's attention read on it (optionally writing the bank
    row), staged in `AttnResidual` for that read (`SGLANG_ROCM_K3_COLUMN_TAIL`, <= 64 tokens).
- Batches the column tail does not take run norm + up-projection + shared + residual add as one kernel
  (`k3_latent_tail`, <= 32 tokens, `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FUSED_LATENT_TAIL`).
- Prefill-sized AttnRes reads (>= 64 rows, bank tile of 8 rows) stream the bank two rows at a time with an online
  softmax (`attn_res_hip._agg_stream_kernel`) instead of holding it in registers.

The sums run in rank order, so every rank gets the same bits.

| New env var | Default |
|---|---|
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FUSED_ATTN_AR_READ` | on |
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FUSED_ATTN_AR_READ_MAX_ROWS` | 4 (two-shot off) |
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_FUSED_LATENT_TAIL` | on |
| `SGLANG_ROCM_K3_COLUMN_TAIL` | on |

## Accuracy Tests

**Setup for every number below:** 8x MI350X (gfx950, 1000 W), Kimi-K3 (MXFP4 MoE, bf16 attention) at TP8 with EAGLE3
(topk 1, 3 steps, 4 draft tokens), FP8 KV cache, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, aiter's K3 FlyDSL kernels
(`AITER_SITUV2_A8W4=1 AITER_FLYDSL_FORCE=1 SGLANG_AITER_K3_OPT=1`), CUDA graphs for bs 1/2/4/8/16, and an aiter bf16 GEMM table with K3 rows re-tuned on this pod with HBM-resident weights
(`AITER_CONFIG_GEMM_BF16`; not part of this PR, it belongs in aiter's model configs). EAGLE3 on K3 needs the
aux-capture commit of #43599, applied locally for these runs. Microbenchmarks rotate their weights through HBM.
Per-feature numbers were measured on the integration branch of this series as each piece landed (Oct 13-14,
earlier `main`); the end-to-end numbers are from the integration of all seven PRs rebased on `main` b67785153a,
together with #43599's aux capture, #41867 and #41848.

- GSM8K 400: column tail 0.99 / accept 3.62; fused attention read 0.985 / 3.613 (200, every verify on the fused
  path); AttnRes streaming 0.985 / 3.62. End-to-end integration: see below.
- `test_k3_ll_collectives.py` (new, 8 GPUs): the all-reduce read (one-shot 4 rows, two-shot 8 and 64 rows, with and
  without the residual) gives the rank-order bf16 sum exactly and the read within rounding, the same on every rank;
  the gather read (1 / 4 / 64 rows, with and without the prefix and the bank write) against torch.distributed.
- `test_kimi_k3_latent_tail_hip.py` (new): the fused tail against norm + GEMM + add; the partials finish to the same
  projection. `test_attn_res_hip.py` (new): the streaming read against the register-tile kernel.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- Column tail + fused next read: C1 decode cycle 17.95 -> 17.25 ms; tail partials ~4 us vs 11.5-13 us replicated.
- Fused attention all-reduce read at 4 rows: C1 cycle 16.02-16.25 -> 15.82-15.92 ms (C4 slower at 16 rows, hence 4).
- Fused latent tail: 13.5 vs 19.5 us (norm + up + add3); -21..-36% over 2-32 rows.
- AttnRes streaming, 8 bank rows: 8192 rows 434 -> 320 us, 2048 rows 114 -> 74 us; uncached 50K prefill
  3.347 -> 3.304 s.

### End to end (all seven PRs)

Integration of the seven PRs on `main` b67785153a, with #43599's aux capture, #41867 and #41848; agentic replay of
lightseekorg/agentic-dataset SWE-smith conversations (multi-turn, ~50K-token cached prefixes, 500 output tokens,
greedy), EAGLE3 as above. TokenSpeed (7e2f1deb, same pod, same workload) for reference.

| Concurrency | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SGLang, tok/s/user | 217.2 | 156.6 | 114.1 | 73.4 | 43.4 |
| TokenSpeed, tok/s/user | 188.1 | 129.5 | 86.1 | 59.7 | 35.5 |

786/786 requests OK. GSM8K 400: 0.9825 / accept length 3.619. Decode cycle C1 / C4 / C16: 15.8 / 23.2 / 38.9 ms;
agentic turn TTFT (50K cached + 1.9K new tokens) 230-248 ms; uncached 50K-token prefill 3.27 s.

## Related

#40000 also shards the latent tail by rows after the all-reduce; this PR splits it by columns for decode and fuses
the all-gather with the next attention read (the prefill row-sharded tail is part 3 of this stack).

+# On gfx950, batches of at least STREAM_MIN_ROWS whose bank tile pads to 8 rows read
+# the bank two rows at a time instead (_agg_stream_kernel): many CTAs per CU then beat
+# one register-bound CTA. Measured on MI350X; at 4 rows the register tile still wins.

+STREAM_MIN_TILE_ROWS: int = 8

     tl.store(out_ptr + t * stride_o + offs, acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty), mask=mask)
 
 
+@triton.jit
+def _agg_stream_kernel(
+    prefix_ptr,  # [T, H]
+    addend_ptr,  # [T, H]; the pending residual, or prefix_ptr when not HAS_ADD
+    prefix_out_ptr,  # [T, H]; materialized prefix, written when HAS_ADD
+    bank_ptr,  # [T, NB, H]
+    cw_ptr,  # [H] fp32; score_norm weight * score_proj weight
+    ow_ptr,  # [H]; out RMSNorm weight, unread when not APPLY_OUT_NORM
+    out_ptr,  # [T, H]
+    score_eps,
+    out_eps,
+    nvb,
+    stride_pm,
+    stride_am,
+    stride_om,
+    stride_bm,
+    stride_bb,
+    stride_o,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_H: tl.constexpr,
+    ROWS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_ADD: tl.constexpr,
+    WRITE_BANK: tl.constexpr,
+    APPLY_OUT_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """_agg_kernel for prefill-sized batches: the bank is read ROWS rows at a time
+    (a runtime loop with an online softmax), so a CTA holds a bounded tile instead
+    of the whole bank and enough CTAs share a CU to stream at HBM bandwidth. Same
+    math as _agg_kernel; the running rescale rounds differently in the last ulp."""
+    t = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_H)
+    mask = offs < H
+
+    row = tl.load(prefix_ptr + t * stride_pm + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    if HAS_ADD:
+        row = (
+            row.to(tl.float32)
+            + tl.load(addend_ptr + t * stride_am + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(
+                tl.float32
+            )
+        ).to(prefix_out_ptr.dtype.element_ty)
+        tl.store(prefix_out_ptr + t * stride_om + offs, row, mask=mask)
+    if WRITE_BANK:
+        tl.store(bank_ptr + t * stride_bm + nvb * stride_bb + offs, row, mask=mask)
+    acc = row.to(tl.float32)
+
+    cw = tl.load(cw_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0)
+    m = tl.sum(acc * cw) / tl.sqrt(tl.sum(acc * acc) / H + score_eps)
+    denom = 1.0
+    offs_r = tl.arange(0, ROWS)
+    for i in range(0, nvb, ROWS):
+        mask_r = (i + offs_r) < nvb
+        tile = tl.load(
+            bank_ptr
+            + t * stride_bm
+            + (i + offs_r)[:, None] * stride_bb
+            + offs[None, :],
+            mask=mask_r[:, None] & mask[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        score = tl.sum(tile * cw[None, :], axis=1) / tl.sqrt(
+            tl.sum(tile * tile, axis=1) / H + score_eps
+        )
+        m_new = tl.maximum(m, tl.max(tl.where(mask_r, score, -float("inf"))))
+        alpha = tl.exp(m - m_new)
+        w = tl.where(mask_r, tl.exp(score - m_new), 0.0)
+        denom = denom * alpha + tl.sum(w)
+        acc = acc * alpha + tl.sum(w[:, None] * tile, axis=0)
+        m = m_new
+    acc = acc / denom
+
+    if APPLY_OUT_NORM:
+        scale = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(tl.sum(acc * acc) / H + out_eps)
+        ow = tl.load(ow_ptr + offs, mask=mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        acc = acc * scale * ow

+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Optional

+import torch

+"""The communicator of Kimi-K3's TP8 LL collectives on gfx950 (csrc/kimi_k3/comm/ll_hip.cuh):
+the attention-residual read's stream gather and the attention output's all-reduce
+read (attention/k3_attn_res_read_hip).
+
+Their scratch is the meta buffer tail of a dedicated aiter CustomAllreduce,
+which is never used for anything else: one region and one row of flags per
+collective.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, NamedTuple, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from aiter.dist.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce import CustomAllreduce
+
+WORLD_SIZE: int = 8
+MAX_ROWS: int = 64
+# Per region: 2 epochs x world x rows x lines-per-row x 16 B (8 payload bytes a
+# line). The kernels hardcode the region order and line counts.
+_LINES_PER_ROW = (2 * 7168 // WORLD_SIZE // 8,)  # gather read: an H / 8 bf16 slice
+# Then the all-reduce read's region: whole rows, two 16-byte lines per 8 bf16.
+AR_MAX_ROWS: int = 16
+_AR_LINES_PER_ROW = 2 * 7168 // 8
+# Then the two-shot all-reduce read's: the owner's rows from each rank, then each row's sum.
+AR2_MAX_ROWS: int = 64
+_SCRATCH_BYTES: int = (
+    sum(2 * WORLD_SIZE * MAX_ROWS * n * 16 for n in _LINES_PER_ROW)
+    + 2 * WORLD_SIZE * AR_MAX_ROWS * _AR_LINES_PER_ROW * 16
+    + 2 * WORLD_SIZE * (AR2_MAX_ROWS // WORLD_SIZE) * _AR_LINES_PER_ROW * 16
+    + 2 * AR2_MAX_ROWS * _AR_LINES_PER_ROW * 16
+)
+
+
+class LLComm(NamedTuple):
+    comm: CustomAllreduce
+    # rank-local flags: [MAX_ROWS] attention-residual gather rows
+    epochs: torch.Tensor
+    # rank-local, [AR_MAX_ROWS] each: the all-reduce read's row flags, and per row the
+    # count of this rank's pushers that took its flag (kept at 0 between launches)
+    ar_epochs: torch.Tensor
+    ar_pushed: torch.Tensor
+    # rank-local, [AR2_MAX_ROWS] each: the two-shot all-reduce read's row flags, and per
+    # row the count of this rank's workgroups done with its flag (kept at 0 between launches)
+    ar2_epochs: torch.Tensor
+    ar2_done: torch.Tensor
+
+
+def create_ll_comm(cpu_group, device: torch.device) -> Optional[LLComm]:
+    """Collective over ``cpu_group`` (a non-NCCL group): every rank calls it,
+    outside graph capture."""
+    from aiter.dist.device_communicators.custom_all_reduce import CustomAllreduce
+
+    # aiter sizes the meta buffer as Signal + 2 * max_size.
+    comm = CustomAllreduce(cpu_group, device, max_size=(_SCRATCH_BYTES + 1) // 2)
+    if comm.disabled or comm.world_size != WORLD_SIZE:
+        return None
+    epochs = torch.zeros(MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ar_epochs = torch.zeros(AR_MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ar_pushed = torch.zeros(AR_MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ar2_epochs = torch.zeros(AR2_MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    ar2_done = torch.zeros(AR2_MAX_ROWS, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    return LLComm(comm, epochs, ar_epochs, ar_pushed, ar2_epochs, ar2_done)

+"""Fused Kimi-K3 latent-MoE tail for small decode batches on gfx950.
+
+One launch for what the TP8 latent MoE otherwise runs as three (RMSNorm, the
+3584 -> 7168 up-projection, and the add3 with the shared-expert output and the
+residual prefix):
+    proj = bf16(inv_rms(latent) * (bf16(latent * norm_weight) @ up_weight.T))
+    out  = bf16(proj + shared [+ prefix])                         # fp32 add
+The per-row 1/rms commutes with the GEMM, so it is accumulated in the same pass
+over the latent and applied in the epilogue; the GEMM input is rounded to bf16
+before the row scale instead of after it, within bf16 noise of the unfused chain.
+
+Decode M is tiny, so this is a skinny GEMM bound by streaming up_weight once:
+each program owns BLOCK_N output columns for all M rows and walks K in full,
+with the weight tile as the MFMA A operand in its natural [N, K] layout.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+
+# Largest decode batch this path is tuned for; larger M keeps the unfused chain,
+# which is faster from M=48 on MI350X with HBM-streamed weights.
+MAX_TOKENS: int = 32
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _latent_tail_kernel(
+    latent_ptr,  # [M, L] bf16
+    norm_w_ptr,  # [L]
+    w_ptr,  # [H, L] bf16
+    shared_ptr,  # [M, H] bf16
+    prefix_ptr,  # [M, H] bf16
+    out_ptr,  # [M, H] bf16
+    M,
+    eps,
+    stride_lm,
+    stride_wn,
+    stride_sm,
+    stride_pm,
+    stride_om,
+    L: tl.constexpr,
+    H: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_PREFIX: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid_n = tl.program_id(0)
+    offs_m = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    mask_m = offs_m < M
+    mask_n = offs_n < H
+
+    # acc[n, m] = sum_k W[n, k] * bf16(x[m, k] * nw[k]); sq[m] = sum_k x[m, k]^2
+    acc = tl.zeros([BLOCK_N, BLOCK_M], dtype=tl.float32)
+    sq = tl.zeros([BLOCK_M], dtype=tl.float32)
+    for k0 in tl.range(0, L, BLOCK_K):
+        offs_k = k0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+        mask_k = offs_k < L
+        xt = tl.load(
+            latent_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_lm + offs_k[:, None],
+            mask=mask_m[None, :] & mask_k[:, None],
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        nw = tl.load(norm_w_ptr + offs_k, mask=mask_k, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        # The weight is streamed once; skip L1 (".cg") so it does not evict x.
+        w = tl.load(
+            w_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * stride_wn + offs_k[None, :],
+            mask=mask_n[:, None] & mask_k[None, :],
+            other=0.0,
+            cache_modifier=".cg",
+        )
+        sq += tl.sum(xt * xt, axis=0)
+        acc += tl.dot(w, (xt * nw[:, None]).to(tl.bfloat16))
+
+    inv_rms = 1.0 / tl.sqrt(sq / L + eps)
+    out = (acc * inv_rms[None, :]).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+    mask = mask_m[None, :] & mask_n[:, None]
+    out += tl.load(
+        shared_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_sm + offs_n[:, None], mask=mask, other=0.0
+    ).to(tl.float32)

+        out += tl.load(
+            prefix_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_pm + offs_n[:, None],
+            mask=mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)

+        out_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_om + offs_n[:, None],
+        out.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty),

+    )

+# The column-parallel tail's split of the latent dim: 3584 = 7 x 512, one chunk per program.
+PARTIAL_SPLITS: int = 7
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _latent_tail_partial_kernel(
+    latent_ptr,  # [M, L] bf16
+    norm_w_ptr,  # [L]
+    w_ptr,  # [N, L] bf16
+    part_ptr,  # [SPLITS, M, N] fp32
+    sq_ptr,  # [SPLITS, M] fp32
+    M,
+    stride_lm,
+    stride_wn,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """One K chunk of the tail's GEMM for BLOCK_N columns; programs of column
+    block 0 also store the chunk's sum of squares of the latent rows."""
+    pid_n = tl.program_id(0)
+    pid_k = tl.program_id(1)
+    offs_m = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+    offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+    offs_k = pid_k * BLOCK_K + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    mask_m = offs_m < M
+    xt = tl.load(
+        latent_ptr + offs_m[None, :] * stride_lm + offs_k[:, None],
+        mask=mask_m[None, :],
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    nw = tl.load(norm_w_ptr + offs_k).to(tl.float32)
+    w = tl.load(
+        w_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * stride_wn + offs_k[None, :],
+        mask=(offs_n < N)[:, None],
+        other=0.0,
+        cache_modifier=".cg",
+    )
+    acc = tl.dot(w, (xt * nw[:, None]).to(tl.bfloat16))
+    tl.store(
+        part_ptr + (pid_k * M + offs_m[None, :]) * N + offs_n[:, None],
+        acc,
+        mask=mask_m[None, :] & (offs_n < N)[:, None],

+        tl.store(sq_ptr + pid_k * M + offs_m, tl.sum(xt * xt, axis=0), mask=mask_m)
+
+
+def k3_latent_tail_partials(
+    latent: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    up_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    # measured on MI350X (N = 896, HBM weights) against 16
+    block_n: int = 32,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """The tail GEMM of up_weight's [N, L] rows, split over L: per chunk k,
+    part[k] = bf16(latent * norm_weight)[:, chunk] @ up_weight[:, chunk].T
+    and sq[k] = sum(latent[:, chunk] ** 2). The consumer finishes the tail:
+    bf16(sum_k part / rms) + shared + prefix (see attention/k3_attn_res_read_hip)."""
+    M, L = latent.shape
+    N = up_weight.shape[0]
+    assert L % PARTIAL_SPLITS == 0
+    part = torch.empty(
+        (PARTIAL_SPLITS, M, N), dtype=torch.float32, device=latent.device
+    )
+    sq = torch.empty((PARTIAL_SPLITS, M), dtype=torch.float32, device=latent.device)
+    _latent_tail_partial_kernel[(triton.cdiv(N, block_n), PARTIAL_SPLITS)](
+        latent,
+        norm_weight,
+        up_weight,
+        part,
+        sq,
+        M,
+        latent.stride(0),
+        up_weight.stride(0),
+        N=N,
+        BLOCK_M=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(M)),
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        BLOCK_K=L // PARTIAL_SPLITS,
+        num_warps=4,
+        num_stages=1,
+        matrix_instr_nonkdim=16,
+    )
+    return part, sq
+
+
+def supports_latent_tail(
+    latent: torch.Tensor,
+    up_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    shared: torch.Tensor,
+    prefix: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+) -> bool:
+    return (
+        0 < latent.shape[0] <= MAX_TOKENS
+        and latent.dtype == up_weight.dtype == shared.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and latent.stride(-1) == 1
+        and up_weight.is_contiguous()
+        and shared.stride(-1) == 1
+        and (
+            prefix is None
+            or (prefix.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and prefix.stride(-1) == 1)
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def k3_latent_tail(
+    latent: torch.Tensor,
+    norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    up_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    shared: torch.Tensor,
+    prefix: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+    *,
+    out: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    block_n: int = 32,
+    block_k: int = 512,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """[prefix +] shared + rmsnorm(latent) @ up_weight.T for M <= MAX_TOKENS rows."""
+    M, L = latent.shape
+    H = up_weight.shape[0]
+    if out is None:
+        out = torch.empty((M, H), dtype=shared.dtype, device=latent.device)
+    # Measured on MI350X at the TP8 K3 shape (L=3584, H=7168), weights from HBM.
+    num_warps, waves_per_eu = (2, 2) if M == 1 else (4, 0)
+    _latent_tail_kernel[(triton.cdiv(H, block_n),)](
+        latent,
+        norm_weight,
+        up_weight,
+        shared,
+        shared if prefix is None else prefix,
+        out,
+        M,
+        eps,
+        latent.stride(0),
+        up_weight.stride(0),
+        shared.stride(0),
+        0 if prefix is None else prefix.stride(0),
+        out.stride(0),
+        L=L,
+        H=H,
+        BLOCK_M=max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(M)),
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        BLOCK_K=block_k,
+        HAS_PREFIX=prefix is not None,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+        num_stages=3,
+        waves_per_eu=waves_per_eu,
+        matrix_instr_nonkdim=16,
+    )
+    return out

+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.kimi_k3_latent_tail_hip import (
+    PARTIAL_SPLITS,
+    k3_latent_tail,
+    k3_latent_tail_partials,
+)
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_gfx95_supported
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# backend-specific: the fused tail serves Kimi-K3's gfx950 TP8 decode path.
+register_amd_ci(est_time=20, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+# Kimi-K3: 3584-wide latent, 7168 hidden; the column tail owns 1/8 of the up_proj rows.
+L, H, EPS = 3584, 7168, 1e-5
+
+
+def _beyond_ulp(got, want):
+    want = want.float()
+    return ((got.float() - want).abs() > want.abs() * 2**-7 + 1e-3).sum().item()
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_gfx95_supported(), "requires gfx950")
+class TestKimiK3LatentTailHip(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        super().setUpClass()
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+        cls.up = (torch.randn(H, L, generator=g, device="cuda") * 0.02).bfloat16()
+        cls.norm_w = (torch.rand(L, generator=g, device="cuda") + 0.5).bfloat16()
+        cls.g = g
+
+    def _inputs(self, rows):
+        g = self.g
+        latent = (torch.randn(rows, L, generator=g, device="cuda") * 3).bfloat16()
+        shared = torch.randn(rows, H, generator=g, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+        prefix = (torch.randn(rows, H, generator=g, device="cuda") * 4).bfloat16()
+        rstd = torch.rsqrt(latent.float().pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
+        scaled = (latent.float() * self.norm_w.float()).bfloat16().float()
+        proj = (rstd * (scaled @ self.up.float().t())).bfloat16()
+        return latent, shared, prefix, proj
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_tail_matches_norm_projection_and_add(self):
+        """One launch equals bf16(rmsnorm(latent) @ up.T) + shared [+ prefix] with
+        an fp32 add, within one bf16 rounding (but where the GEMM's summation order
+        flips the projection's rounding ahead of a cancelling add)."""
+        for rows in (1, 4, 32):
+            latent, shared, prefix, proj = self._inputs(rows)
+            for with_prefix in (False, True):
+                want = proj.float() + shared.float()
+                if with_prefix:
+                    want = want + prefix.float()
+                got = k3_latent_tail(
+                    latent,
+                    self.norm_w,
+                    EPS,
+                    self.up,
+                    shared,
+                    prefix if with_prefix else None,
+                )
+                with self.subTest(rows=rows, prefix=with_prefix):
+                    self.assertLessEqual(
+                        _beyond_ulp(got, want.bfloat16()), got.numel() // 1000
+                    )
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_partials_sum_to_the_tail_projection(self):
+        """The column tail's split-K partials of 1/8 of the up_proj rows, finished
+        as their consumer does (sum over chunks / rms), give the same projection."""
+        rows_n = H // 8
+        up_slice = self.up[3 * rows_n : 4 * rows_n]
+        for rows in (1, 4, 64):
+            latent, _, _, proj = self._inputs(rows)
+            part, sq = k3_latent_tail_partials(latent, self.norm_w, up_slice)
+            self.assertEqual(tuple(part.shape), (PARTIAL_SPLITS, rows, rows_n))
+            inv_rms = torch.rsqrt(sq.sum(0) / L + EPS)
+            got = (part.sum(0) * inv_rms[:, None]).bfloat16()
+            with self.subTest(rows=rows):
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    sq.sum(0), latent.float().pow(2).sum(-1), rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-3
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(_beyond_ulp(got, proj[:, 3 * rows_n : 4 * rows_n]), 0)
